name: 道の駅 大和
desc: 佐賀市大和町の国道263号沿い、嘉瀬川上流の豊かな自然に囲まれた「道の駅 大和（そよかぜ館）」。鳥をモチーフにした木造の建物が目印です。直売所には毎朝採れる新鮮な野菜や松梅米が並び、特産の干し柿やそれを使った羊羹・アイスなどの名物グルメが大人気。さらに、伝統工芸「名尾和紙」のグッズやオートキャンプ場も併設されており、ドライブ途中のリフレッシュやアウトドアまで幅広く楽しめるスポットです。
descEn: Located along National Route 263 in Yamato-cho, Saga City, "Michi-no-Eki Yamato (Soyokaze-kan)" is nestled in the rich nature along the upper reaches of the Kase River. Its distinctive wooden main building is designed in the shape of a bird. The local market offers freshly harvested vegetables and Matsubai rice, alongside popular regional delicacies like traditional dried persimmons and unique processed treats such as persimmon paste ice cream and yokan. Complete with traditional "Naowashi" paper crafts and an adjacent auto campground, it is a wonderful spot to refresh during a drive and enjoy outdoor leisure.
